overview_description.description:
Salto is the leading solution for business application configuration. By adapting and applying software development concepts and best practices to the business operations world, Salto provides an Open Source and an Enterprise SaaS product that re-imagines multi-application configuration in the modern company.

Salto's solution automatically extracts the configurations of different business applications - including Salesforce, NetSuite and HubSpot - and translates them to a new declarative representation called NaCl (“Not Another Configuration Language”). Using NaCl with Git, all applications’ configurations can be collaboratively edited and deployed back to the live business applications, or to a staging environment for testing. With Salto, configuration changes to multiple business applications can be easily tested, tracked or even rolled back if needed.

Salto was founded in 2019 by veteran Israeli entrepreneurs Rami Tamir, Benny Schnaider and Gil Hoffer and is their latest startup, after successes with previous companies - Pentacom (acquired by Cisco), Qumranet (acquired by Red Hat) and Ravello Systems (acquired by Oracle). It is backed by leading investors such as Bessmer Venture Partners, Lightspeed Venture Partners and Salesforce Ventures and has offices in Tel Aviv and San Francisco.

product.name: Salto Enterprise Application Configuration Management
product.description: A platform for managing and deploying configuration changes across enterprise applications with automated deployments, change tracking, backup, and security remediation.

product.name: Salto for Salesforce
product.description: A solution to manage Salesforce metadata and CPQ data, enabling comparison, deployment, and version control of Salesforce configurations.

product.name: Salto for NetSuite
product.description: A tool to track, document, and automate deployment of NetSuite customizations and configuration changes across environments.

product.name: Salto for Zendesk
product.description: A platform to manage and synchronize Zendesk configurations, including rules, automations, and customizations between environments.

product.name: Salto for Jira
product.description: A solution for managing Jira configurations, enabling comparison, cloning, and deployment of schemes, workflows, and projects between instances.

product.name: Salto for Okta
product.description: A tool to manage Okta tenant configurations with change comparison, safe deployment, automated backup, and recovery capabilities.
